scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:core && npm run typecheck:adapters && npm run typecheck:testing
scripts.lint: npm run lint:core && npm run lint:adapters && npm run lint:testing
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:adapters && npm run test:testing
scripts.verify: npm run verify:hardening && npm run typecheck:core && npm run typecheck:adapters && npm run typecheck:testing && npm run lint:core && npm run lint:adapters && npm run lint:testing && npm run test:core && npm run test:adapters && npm run test:testing
scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core/tsconfig.build.json packages/adapters/tsconfig.build.json packages/testing/tsconfig.build.json && tsx scripts/verification/rewriteBuildExtensions.ts packages/core packages/adapters packages/testing
